investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-09-15T20:17Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error indicating the swarm provisioning gateway — an AWS ELB endpoint at /v1/agents in us-east-2 — was unreachable. investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting the /v1/agents provisioning path) was unreachable at the time of the eval run. The production-api layer returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning: error sending request for url (http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents)" for every POST /api/agents call. This is a shared upstream dependency failure: all three remote-agents checks hit the same gateway and all failed with the identical error message, producing zero evidence. This is an eval-observed infrastructure failure localized to the swarm gateway and the remote-agents provisioning path; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence to confirm a broader production outage.

investigations.summary: The image-generation-stream eval failed because the OpenAI API key used by the eval runner has no remaining credits, causing the upstream API to return a credit_balance_exhausted error. investigations.title: model-matrix eval failure: aura-gpt-5-5 returns 502/424 provider_account_unavailable
investigations.summary: The model-matrix eval failed because exactly one of two configured models, aura-gpt-5-5, returned a 502 Bad Gateway wrapping a 424 Failed Dependency with error code provider_account_unavailable from the upstream LLM provider. The sibling model aura-claude-sonnet-4-6 passed cleanly, isolating the failure to the aura-gpt-5-5 provider path only.
investigations.rootCause: AURA's backend was temporarily unable to reach the model provider for aura-gpt-5-5 at the time of the eval run (2026-09-15T20:16:41Z). The runtime test endpoint POST /api/agents/[REDACTED]/runtime/test returned HTTP 502 containing a 424 Failed Dependency with error code provider_account_unavailable and the message "AURA is temporarily unable to reach the model provider. This is an issue on our side, not with your account or credits." This is a provider-side or AURA-to-provider connectivity failure scoped exclusively to the aura-gpt-5-5 model route. No eval infrastructure failure, missing evidence, or code defect is indicated; all required evidence fields were present and the eval runner executed correctly. This is an eval failure reflecting a real backend condition, not a user-traffic incident — no traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
